review.instruction: Confirm the exact repository-owned suite ran as an external client against the attested endpoint and served head containing the pinned commit; reject bespoke cases, substituted commands and inferred runtime addresses.
Match every case to raw runner output and judge contract, data and lifecycle separately. A named case that failed, was skipped or produced no evidence cannot pass.
Verify every created record carries the run namespace, was read back through the API, and cleanup deleted exactly that namespace without touching pre-existing or foreign records.
Confirm the run identity is new, prior records remain unchanged, and neither output nor command evidence contains credential values.

failurePolicy: Evaluate machine and review criteria after producing evidence. Record concrete defects, repair only the failed criterion within the bounded feedback loop, rerun affected checks, and return done only when every criterion passes.
